[A useful first message]{.eyebrow}

## A useful first message. {.sec-h}

1. What decision, strategic question or learning challenge is in view?
2. Who needs to take part, and what can they influence?
3. What have you tried, and what would a useful next step help you decide?

You can enquire about the Strategic Decision Workshop, Knowledge Sharing & Organisational Learning Lab, Strategy Prototyping Studio, executive facilitation or a custom masterclass. If you have a preferred format, include approximate group size and timing; delivery details are agreed during scoping.

[Write an enquiry](mailto:contact@spottedape.com?subject=Strategic%20workshop%20enquiry){.btn-p}

Or email **[contact@spottedape.com](mailto:contact@spottedape.com)**.

An enquiry begins a discussion of fit, context and scope. Delivery arrangements and fees are agreed before an engagement is confirmed. Do not send confidential documents in your initial message.

:::
